rec.name: Application Steps (Tabbed Image Steps with Progress Bar)
rec.status: Built — launched (QA confirmed working, docs written)

what.text: A theme-editor section that shows a product's usage or application as a row of numbered step images (e.g. 01–04) with a progress bar underneath. Clicking a step image makes it active, advances the progress bar, and swaps the heading and description text below. Each step is a block with an image, a heading and rich text. Rebuilt from the Piwi skincare PDP, where it explains how to use the oil (Cleansing, Effect, Care, Additional care).

why.text: Showing how to use a product step by step lowers perceived effort and uncertainty, especially for products with a routine such as skincare. Numbered visuals chunk the information into small steps. The progress bar gives a sense of progress and a clear sequence. Seeing the product in use builds confidence and shows the product's value before purchase, which reduces hesitation and post-purchase misuse and returns.

how.text: Add the section file (ed-cro-application-steps.liquid) to the theme and place it on the product page template, or any page, through the theme editor. Add one block per step and upload an image (same format, ideally a white or neutral background so the fade works). Enter a heading and short text for each step. The first step is active by default. A small custom JS tab script toggles the active image, shows the matching text and sets progress to (index+1)/total. It is scoped per section, so the section can be duplicated on one page, and it re-initialises on shopify:section:load in the editor. A CSS gradient fades each image into the section background, and the step number sits over the faded area. Non-developers can set it up through the theme editor with the setup guide.

items: Default colour (inactive numbers and progress track)
Active colour (active number and progress fill)
Gap between step images (desktop and mobile)
Custom font family toggle and font picker
Number size, heading size and content size (desktop and mobile variants)
Block settings per step: image, heading, rich text content

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify OS 2.0 theme (built to mirror Focal theme styling and its global colour settings). No metafields or apps required. Step images should share one format (same ratio) and ideally have a white or neutral background so the gradient fade works. The Asana comments mention a Slite doc and a setup guide. The code should be shared as a .zip with .liquid files, not .rtf. Not stated in the ticket whether Home or other pages are officially supported. The page types beyond PDP are inferred from the section being placed on a Home page in the editor screenshot.

items: Scroll depth / visibility of the section
Return rate and support enquiries about product usage (long term)

images.caption: Final UI on the Piwi reference: four step images faded to white with large numbers 01–04, a progress bar and the heading 'REINIGUNG' plus step text.

Shopify theme editor showing the section with blocks (Reinigung, Wirkstoffe, Pflege, Zusätzliche Pflege) and the settings panel (spacing, width, max-width, show number, colours, gap, font, sizes, uppercase).
